message.content: From the conversation between WolfgangSchulz and LiHua, Wolfgang prefers a well-done meat patty in a burger because he believes it is safer and more flavorful. He appreciates the "little char on my burger" and emphasizes that he likes the juicy texture of a well-done patty. Despite acknowledging that medium rare is popular and enjoys the juicy texture, Wolfgang opts for a well-done burger due to his preference for safety and taste. This preference aligns with his inclination towards well-cooked meats, as evident from his discussion about the ideal degree of doneness for the meat patty in a classic American cheeseburger.
